scenario: xfs mount whose super options carry an enforced project-quota key and an accounting-only group-quota key (prjquota,gqnoenforce): one path, one mount, two quota types with different enforcement.

fixture.mountinfo:
1 0 259:1 / / rw,relatime shared:1 - ext4 /dev/nvme0n1p2 rw,data=ordered
25 0 0:22 / /proc rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec,relatime shared:5 - proc proc rw
36 1 253:2 / /data rw,relatime shared:1 - xfs /dev/mapper/data rw,inode64,prjquota,gqnoenforce

rationale: Contract table row: 'xfs | any of usrquota,uquota,quota,grpquota,gquota,prjquota,pquota and no `noquota` | enabled | enforced | `xfs_quota_option`'. The chosen mount line's super options (last mountinfo field) are 'rw,inode64,prjquota,gqnoenforce'; comma-split keys are rw, inode64, prjquota, gqnoenforce. 'prjquota' is one of the row's quota keys and 'noquota' is absent, so this row matches and the row 'only *noenforce keys' does not (a quota key, prjquota, is present alongside the noenforce key gqnoenforce). quota_state=enabled, enforcement=enforced, basis=xfs_quota_option. Mount resolution: candidates for realpath /data/projects are the root mount '/' and '/data'; the longest mount point wins, so mount_point=/data and fstype=xfs (the root ext4 line is not selected). Device check: fstype is xfs (not btrfs) and the super options line's major:minor 253:2 equals the path's st_dev 253:2, so no device_mismatch and the path is classified, not left unknown. Verdict precedence: no setup error, and one path is enabled, so exit 1 with finding_id QUOTA_ENABLED (a runway-reporting finding, not a failure claim). Source anchors: S078 fs/xfs/xfs_super.c at tag v7.2 - option table fsparam_flag('prjquota', Opt_prjquota) and fsparam_flag('gqnoenforce', Opt_gqnoenforce) (option table, xfs_fs_parameters), the parse cases Opt_pquota/Opt_prjquota setting (XFS_PQUOTA_ACCT|XFS_PQUOTA_ENFD) and Opt_gqnoenforce setting XFS_GQUOTA_ACCT and clearing XFS_GQUOTA_ENFD (so the two quota types differ in enforcement), and xfs_fs_show_options printing ',prjquota' when XFS_PQUOTA_ENFD is set, ',gqnoenforce' when only XFS_GQUOTA_ACCT is set, and ',noquota' only when !(m_qflags & XFS_ALL_QUOTA_ACCT) (hence a real xfs super-options string never carries 'noquota' together with a quota key, and the conflicting-options row is unreachable for kernel-generated super options); S077 Documentation/admin-guide/xfs.rst at tag v7.2 - mount options 'noquota', 'uquota/usrquota/uqnoenforce/quota', 'gquota/grpquota/gqnoenforce', 'pquota/prjquota/pqnoenforce' (accounting enabled, limits optionally enforced); S082 Documentation/filesystems/proc.rst at tag v7.2 section 3.5 - mountinfo field layout (mount ID, parent ID, major:minor, root, mount point, mount options, optional tagged fields up to the '-' separator, filesystem type, mount source, super options) and the optional-field forms shared:X, master:X, propagate_from:X, unbindable. Realism of the fixture strings rests additionally on kernel code outside the S077-S084 range (fs/proc_namespace.c at v7.2: super options are emitted as ' ro'/' rw' plus show_sb_opts plus sb->s_op->show_options, so the xfs super options legitimately begin with 'rw'; mount points are escaped with seq_path_root over ' \t\n\\', i.e. \040, \011, \012, \134, and no escaping occurs in this fixture). Ambiguity flagged to L1: the contract states one enforcement token per path, but xfs enforcement is per quota type (project enforced, group accounting-only here). Row 'only *noenforce keys' is not matched, so the path-level value is 'enforced' (the stronger of the two types); this is the conservative reading for FR2, but a reader could wrongly infer that every quota type on this mount is enforced. The contract also does not state row precedence explicitly, nor whether 'enforced' means 'at least one quota type enforced' or 'all quota types enforced'.
